subject: Re: BrightStack accelerator — request for expanded promo credits & extension
body:
From: Sara Ngu <sara@brightstack.io>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightStack accelerator — request for expanded promo credits & extension

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the team at BrightStack is excited about what Redwood can do for our demo pipeline. Quick ask: our cohort start date shifted by two weeks and the original pilot credit pack is now tight for the expanded PoC we want to run.

Can we request an increase from the standard 50k trial credits to 120k, and extend the trial window by 30 days? The program runs a mix of fine-tuning experiments and higher-throughput inference for demo sessions, so both the credit amount and the time extension matter.

I attached our accelerator SOW and a short timeline. If you need a sponsor note from BrightStack’s program lead I can loop them in, but we’re hoping for a quick yes so we can finalize our kickoff.

Best,
Sara Ngu
Founder, BrightStack Accelerator
partners@brightstack.io

Attachments: Accelerator_Onboarding_SOW.pdf (summary), timeline.xlsx (referenced)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Sara Ngu <sara@brightstack.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightStack accelerator — request for expanded promo credits & extension

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and for sharing the SOW.

Short answer: we can usually accommodate exceptions for verified accelerator partners, but I need to confirm a couple things with the team (finance + CS) before I lock in the numbers and extension. Can you confirm both of the following so I can fast-track approvals?

1) Will BrightStack be listed as an official Redwood partner in our program directory for the cohort? (this affects marketing credits)
2) Do you expect any data residency or SOC2-evidence requirements from participants in this cohort?

If the answers are yes/no respectively we have a straightforward path. I’m looping in Monica (Customer Success) to confirm onboarding cadence. I’ll follow up with formal terms and a DocuSign for the credit amendment.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment referenced: Promo_Terms_Escrow.docx (draft)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: BrightStack accelerator — request for expanded promo credits & extension

Team — forwarding BrightStack's ask. Key details: requesting 120k credits (standard offer is 50k) and +30 days extension to trial window due to cohort start shift. They are an accelerator program; potential logo/partner listing if we agree.

What I need:
- Laura / Partnerships: confirm whether we can add them to the program directory and whether that affects our promo policy.
- Rishi / Finance: can you sign off on a 2.4x credit uplift under a promo escrow arrangement? If we require a cost-share, suggest options (e.g., 50% upfront commitment from program).
- Monica / CS: confirm onboarding bandwidth for 12 cohort startups and whether we need SOC2 evidence.

I’ve attached the SOW and a draft promo-terms doc. I’d like to respond to Sara by EOD with a path forward.

Thanks,
Marcus

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:49:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: BrightStack accelerator — request for expanded promo credits & extension

Quick alignment from Partnerships: we can include BrightStack in the program directory as a verified accelerator partner provided they agree to a short co-marketing blurb and allow a single joint webinar. That gives us a policy basis to approve an uplift. No additional legal gating beyond standard partner MOU.

I’m OK with approving an uplift to 120k on the condition that:
- Credits are escrowed to the program account and expire 60 days after cohort completion (to avoid long open-ended liabilities), and
- BrightStack signs the promo amendment (DocuSign) acknowledging co-marketing and the credit expiry policy.

If Finance wants a cost-share, propose a 25% share to offset uplift.

Laura Bennett | Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: BrightStack accelerator — request for expanded promo credits & extension

I reviewed the numbers. 120k credits is acceptable under promo escrow with the following guardrails:
- 25% sponsor contribution (one-time) or a refundable commitment of $1,500 against consumption, whichever BrightStack prefers.
- Credits issued to a program-level account and redeemed by cohort startups; audit log retained for 12 months.
- Extension of trial window by +30 days is fine, final expiry = cohort_end + 60 days per Laura’s note.

Monica, please confirm CS bandwidth for enforcement and onboarding. If CS is comfortable I’ll prepare the promo amendment and invoice option.

Rishi Malhotra | Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Sara Ngu <sara@brightstack.io>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightStack accelerator — request for expanded promo credits & extension

Hi Sara — great to meet you on the call. We can proceed under the terms Partners/Finance approved: 120,000 promo credits allocated to a BrightStack program account, trial extended +30 days, and credits will expire 60 days after the cohort end date. To finalize we need either 

A) 25% sponsor contribution (one-time invoice) or
B) refundable $1,500 commitment (applied if consumption exceeds allocation).

Please confirm which option you prefer and accept the DocuSign amendment. Once we get that we’ll schedule the onboarding slots for cohort startups (I have tentatively blocked two sessions the week before your cohort).

Thanks — Monica Patel | Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Promo_Terms_Escrow.docx (final draft)

On Tue, Jun 22, 2027 at 08:12 AM Sara Ngu <sara@brightstack.io> wrote:
> Thanks Monica — we’ll take option A (25% sponsor contribution). Can you send the invoice and the DocuSign?
>
> Also please include the single webinar in the co-marketing clause (we’ll coordinate dates).
>
> —Sara

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Sara Ngu <sara@brightstack.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightStack accelerator — request for expanded promo credits & extension (Final)

Sara — great, thank you and welcome aboard. Summary and next steps: 

- Promo uplift approved: 120,000 credits assigned to BrightStack program account.
- Trial window extended +30 days; credits expire cohort_end + 60 days.
- Sponsor contribution: 25% invoice to BrightStack (I’ve routed to Finance).
- DocuSign amendment: link below (please sign).
- Onboarding: Monica will reach out with two session slots and a pre-kickoff checklist.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/receipt/ABC-123456789
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8675309

We’ll get the invoice over within 24 hours and will lock the credits once payment is processed. Looking forward to the cohort — let us know preferred dates for the webinar and Monica will coordinate.

Best,
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
